diagnosis: The scenario failed the Weak Arm gate because all rollouts resulted in identical decisions (approve_license: true, worldwide territories, 5% royalty, sublicensing allowed) that completely ignore the constraints imposed by PF1 and PF2. Specifically, the model consistently defaults to a 'worldwide' territory instead of the required 'United States and Germany' (C2/PF1) and a generic 'battery-management technology' field instead of 'grid-scale battery storage' (C4/PF2).
